# GNUstep Icons 0.5 — abgr

`GNUstep-0.5.tar.gz` is the **unmodified original** `GNUstep.tar.gz`
(641,077 bytes) uploaded by **abgr**, last release 2018-12-02.

- Project: https://www.gnome-look.org/p/1239539
- Metadata: https://api.opendesktop.org/ocs/v1/content/data/1239539
- SHA-256: `d641f595e09d1e79b81ead824cce5461f0ad3dbae7d8914a9a227686024ad131`
- Licence: **GPLv3 as declared by the uploader** (the listing's `gplv3` tag).
  The archive itself contains no licence file. `COPYING.GPL-3.0` supplies the
  licence text, from https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt.
- Attribution: the author describes their work as collecting/organizing GNUstep
  icons, with some original work. Underlying artwork retains its authorship;
  this declaration is not independent clearance of every constituent image.

The OCS API returns an expiring, signed `files06.pling.com/api/files/download/j/…`
URL. Searches for abgr/andbgr's theme on GitHub, distro/AUR mirrors and the web
found no stable download. andbgr's GitHub hosts QTStep, not this icon theme.
Debian's `gnustep-icons` is a **different input**, not this freedesktop theme.
Vendoring avoids embedding an inevitably expiring token in the derivation.

To refresh, fetch the API, download its `downloadlink1` into `.work/`, inspect
it, then compare hashes before replacing this archive. The Nix expression
checks its hash even though it is vendored. No OPENSTEP archive, converted
OPENSTEP icons, or `wmicons` artwork is vendored.
